midnight-plum.$description: Midnight Plum — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis.

deep-plum.$description: Deep Plum — Accent card background — a slightly lifted version of Midnight Plum, used for dark-themed product/feature cards to create tonal variation within the dark family

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis

lime-sherbet.$description: Lime Sherbet — Accent card background — high-key lime used as a rotating card surface color. High contrast against Midnight Plum text makes it ideal for dark-on-light product cards

bubblegum-pink.$description: Bubblegum Pink — Red supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

warm-bone.$description: Warm Bone — Page canvas — the warm off-white that fills the body of every content section. Slightly cream-toned to feel inviting rather than clinical

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surfaces and nav background — used for elevated cards on the Warm Bone canvas, and for the sticky top navigation bar

silver-mist.$description: Silver Mist — Hairline borders, input outlines, and card edge definition. Also functions as the inset shadow color on buttons (rgb(228, 227, 223) inset ring)

storm-gray.$description: Storm Gray — Primary muted text — body copy, nav links, secondary descriptions. Near-gray with a slight cool violet undertone matching the brand

slate-gray.$description: Slate Gray — Secondary text — captions, helper text, fine print, and less prominent body copy

charcoal-plum.$description: Charcoal Plum — Dark UI text and button borders — used on pill buttons and nav controls where a softer dark than Midnight Plum is needed

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Tertiary neutral — placeholder text, disabled states, and very low-emphasis UI elements

klarna-title.$description: Custom display font used exclusively for headings and hero text. Sizes escalate dramatically (40→58→90px) with tight 1.05-1.10 line-height — the 90px hero weight is a signature: oversized geometric type that commands the viewport. Normal letter-spacing at these sizes lets the letterforms breathe at their natural width.

klarna-text.$description: Custom UI/body font for navigation labels, input text, and smaller headings. Slight negative tracking (-0.01em) tightens display usage; -0.003em for body keeps text compact without feeling cramped. Weight 500 for nav, 700 for subheadings, 400 for body.

apple-system.$description: System font fallback for body text, links, buttons, and general UI at 12-20px. Tighter line-heights (1.14-1.20) for compact UI elements, relaxed 1.43-1.50 for readable body paragraphs.
